en: Jupiter is so large that about 1,300 Earths could fit inside it.
The Moon is approximately 384,400 kilometers away from Earth on average.
Diamond is the hardest natural mineral, scoring a ten on the Mohs scale, while talc scores one.
The 1990 Luzon earthquake in the Philippines had a massive magnitude of 7.8.
Super Typhoon Yolanda reached one-minute maximum sustained winds of 235 kilometers per hour.
The surface temperature of our Sun is about 5,500 degrees Celsius.
Clay particles in soil are smaller than 0.002 millimeters across.
Oceans hold about 97 percent of all the water found on Earth.
Ceres is the largest object in the asteroid belt, measuring about 940 kilometers across.
The troposphere, where weather happens, extends about 12 kilometers above Earth's surface.
Mount Mayon in the Philippines has a nearly perfect cone and stands 2,462 meters tall.
Proxima Centauri, the closest star to our solar system, is 4.24 light-years away.
